description: Elastic Security SIEM alert rules — database-security

rules.name: PostgreSQL — Privilege Escalation via SET ROLE
rules.description: Detects PostgreSQL SET ROLE attempts for privilege escalation
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("postgresql" OR "privilege-escalation" OR "sql")

rules.name: PostgreSQL — pg_dump Data Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects PostgreSQL pg_dump commands indicating potential data exfiltration
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("postgresql" OR "data-exfiltration" OR "sql")

rules.name: PostgreSQL — Row-Level Security Bypass
rules.description: Detects PostgreSQL queries bypassing row-level security policies
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("postgresql" OR "rls-bypass" OR "sql")

rules.name: MySQL — UNION-Based SQL Injection
rules.description: Detects UNION-based SQL injection attacks against MySQL databases
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("mysql" OR "sql-injection" OR "sql")

rules.name: MySQL — Root Account Remote Login
rules.description: Detects remote login attempts to MySQL root account from non-localhost
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("mysql" OR "default-account" OR "sql")

rules.name: SQL Server — xp_cmdshell Execution
rules.description: Detects execution of xp_cmdshell stored procedure enabling OS command execution
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("sqlserver" OR "command-execution" OR "sql")

rules.name: SQL Server — SUSPENDED Login State Anomaly
rules.description: Detects SQL Server logins in SUSPENDED state indicating potential credential abuse
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("sqlserver" OR "login-anomaly" OR "sql")

rules.name: Oracle — DBA Privilege Escalation
rules.description: Detects Oracle DBA privilege escalation attempts via GRANT DBA or ALTER USER
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("oracle" OR "privilege-escalation" OR "sql")

rules.name: SQLite — Direct File Access from Web
rules.description: Detects direct SQLite database file access from web applications
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("sqlite" OR "file-access" OR "sql")

rules.name: MongoDB — NoSQL Injection via $where
rules.description: Detects MongoDB $where operator injection for JavaScript execution
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("mongodb" OR "nosql-injection" OR "nosql")

rules.name: MongoDB — admin Database Unauthorized Access
rules.description: Detects unauthorized access to MongoDB admin database
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("mongodb" OR "default-account" OR "nosql")

rules.name: DynamoDB — Excessive Scan Operations
rules.description: Detects excessive DynamoDB Scan operations indicating potential data exfiltration
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("dynamodb" OR "data-exfiltration" OR "nosql")

rules.name: Cassandra — Unauthorized CQL Command Execution
rules.description: Detects unauthorized CQL commands including ALTER, DROP, and GRANT operations
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("cassandra" OR "privilege-escalation" OR "nosql")

rules.name: CouchDB — Admin Party Mode
rules.description: Detects CouchDB admin party mode or unauthorized admin access
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("couchdb" OR "default-account" OR "nosql")

rules.name: Firestore — Overly Permissive Security Rules
rules.description: Detects Firestore security rules allowing unauthenticated read/write access
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("firestore" OR "misconfiguration" OR "nosql")

rules.name: Neo4j — Cypher Injection Attack
rules.description: Detects Cypher injection attacks in Neo4j graph database queries
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("neo4j" OR "cypher-injection" OR "graph")

rules.name: ArangoDB — AQL Injection Detection
rules.description: Detects AQL injection attacks in ArangoDB queries
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("arangodb" OR "aql-injection" OR "graph")

rules.name: Neptune — Gremlin/SPARQL Injection
rules.description: Detects Gremlin or SPARQL injection attacks against Amazon Neptune
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("neptune" OR "graph-injection" OR "graph")

rules.name: InfluxDB — Unauthorized Data Deletion
rules.description: Detects DROP DATABASE or DELETE SERIES commands in InfluxDB
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("influxdb" OR "data-destruction" OR "timeseries")

rules.name: TimescaleDB — Hypertable Data Exfiltration
rules.description: Detects bulk data extraction from TimescaleDB hypertables
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("timescaledb" OR "data-exfiltration" OR "timeseries")

rules.name: Prometheus — Unauthorized Metric Scraping
rules.description: Detects unauthorized metric scraping from Prometheus endpoints revealing infrastructure details
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("prometheus" OR "information-disclosure" OR "timeseries")

rules.name: Pinecone — Namespace Isolation Bypass
rules.description: Detects cross-namespace data access in Pinecone vector database
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("pinecone" OR "vector" OR "isolation-bypass")

rules.name: Weaviate — Tenant Data Isolation Failure
rules.description: Detects cross-tenant data access in Weaviate vector database
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("weaviate" OR "vector" OR "isolation-bypass")

rules.name: Milvus — Collection-Level Access Bypass
rules.description: Detects unauthorized collection access in Milvus vector database
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("milvus" OR "vector" OR "access-bypass")

rules.name: ChromaDB — Embedding Poisoning Detection
rules.description: Detects adversarial embedding vectors inserted into ChromaDB collections
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("chromadb" OR "vector" OR "embedding-poisoning")

rules.name: Qdrant — Payload Filter Injection
rules.description: Detects filter injection attacks in Qdrant vector search payloads
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("qdrant" OR "vector" OR "filter-injection")

rules.name: Redis — CONFIG GET Credential Exposure
rules.description: Detects Redis CONFIG commands targeting credentials or authentication configuration
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("redis" OR "credential-exposure" OR "key-value")

rules.name: Redis — FLUSHALL/FLUSHDB Data Destruction
rules.description: Detects Redis FLUSHALL or FLUSHDB commands indicating potential data destruction
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("redis" OR "data-destruction" OR "key-value")

rules.name: Memcached — Amplification Attack
rules.description: Detects Memcached amplification attacks via stats or get requests from external IPs
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("memcached" OR "amplification" OR "key-value")

rules.name: HBase — Unauthorized ACL Modification
rules.description: Detects unauthorized ACL modifications in HBase including grant and revoke operations
rules.query: event.category:("network" OR "authentication" OR "database" OR "iam") AND ("hbase" OR "acl-modification" OR "column-family")
